content: HITL = inserting human approve/reject/edit checkpoints into autonomous AI workflows at critical decision points; standard guidance reserves it for high-stakes/regulated outputs. Katara built an AI-agent Diataxis workflow: a content classifier maps existing content to the right Diataxis category and finds gaps/overlaps, with an optional human-in-the-loop circuit at EVERY step for feedback or direct editing. Confirms type-aware (Diataxis) generation + per-step HITL editing already exist as a combined product pattern.
